about: Regression cases for the fix-ai-tell-prose rulebook. All text is invented for invented businesses. Run the skill on each 'text' as pasted copy and check: every ID in 'expect' is found (as a finding's pattern or on its Also line), no other numbered findings appear, every string in 'must_keep' survives in the rewrites, and nothing new (names, numbers, sources) is added. Cases with expect: [] are false-positive checks: the skill should report no findings. See docs/validation-protocol.md.
